project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (TypeScript), deployed to Vercel Hobby free tier; Supabase free tier as the only backend (Postgres + Storage + Realtime); Google Maps JavaScript API for the map.
build_system: npm + Next.js built-in build (webpack; do NOT enable turbopack flag during scaffold to avoid flakiness). Node v24.13.0, npm 11.10.0. Tailwind v4 uses CSS-first config: @tailwindcss/postcss in postcss.config.mjs and `@import "tailwindcss";` in src/app/globals.css (NOT a tailwind.config.js content array). create-next-app scaffolds this automatically.
test_framework: No heavyweight test runner required. Verification is build + typecheck + lint + manual render in mock mode. If a pure-logic unit test is warranted (expense split math), add vitest and a single test file; otherwise rely on build/typecheck.
test_command: npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
verification_instructions: From d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site: (1) ensure NO .env.local present (mock mode); (2) `npm run lint` passes; (3) `npx tsc --noEmit` passes; (4) `npm run build` succeeds; (5) `npm run dev` and load http://localhost:3000 — every segment (Dashboard, Itinerary, Map, Group, Money, Logistics, Moments) renders and is navigable without secrets. Confirm a throwaway .env.local is git-ignored via `git status --ignored`, then delete it.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in by build. The SQL migration (supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql) and seed (supabase/seed.sql) are hand-written and committed, not generated.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Scaffold INTO the existing repo root d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site which already contains .git and .agents — create-next-app must target '.' and tolerate those dirs. FREE-TIER HARD RULE: no paid Vercel/Supabase features, no always-on server processes, compress images client-side before upload, Google Maps key must be referrer-restricted with a hard quota cap. NEVER hardcode secrets; read from env. .env.local must be gitignored from the FIRST commit; .env.local.example (placeholders only) is committed.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or steering files exist in this repo. Conventions to follow: App Router with route groups, src/ dir, @/* import alias, TypeScript strict. First git commit is made inside FEAT-001. Commit locally only; never push.
key_patterns: Repository pattern in src/lib/data/repository.ts routes every read/write/subscribe to Supabase when env vars are present, else to an in-memory mock store (src/lib/data/mock-store.ts) hydrated from seed. supabaseAvailable boolean gates this. Supabase clients via @supabase/ssr (browser + server). Editor auth: POST /api/editor/unlock compares to EDITOR_PASSWORD (server-only env), sets httpOnly cookie; useEditor() hook exposes canEdit; all mutations gated by canEdit. Google Maps loaded via @googlemaps/js-api-loader with a graceful static fallback when the key is absent. Images compressed with browser-image-compression before Storage upload. Seed data is the single source of truth transcribed verbatim from the itinerary.
relevant_files: d:\Personal-Projects\_itinerary_extracted.txt  (SOURCE OF TRUTH for all seed data — read for exact mileage, drive-times, stops, costs, warnings, open decisions)
directory_structure: src/app/* App Router pages + route groups ((app) for the main segmented shell, /moments public page, /api/editor route handlers). src/components/* per-feature component folders (nav, ui, dashboard, itinerary, places, rental, map, group, expenses, budget, drivers, checklist, vault, weather, decisions, gallery, moments, countdown). src/lib/* types, seed, supabase clients, data repository + mock store, maps, images, money. supabase/* SQL migration + seed. Root: SETUP.md, README.md, .env.local.example.
